newsitem.title: EU: EC REPORT WEEKLY DIARY FOR MONDAY, FEB 10 - SUNDAY, FEB 16.
newsitem.headline: EC REPORT WEEKLY DIARY FOR MONDAY, FEB 10 - SUNDAY, FEB 16.

text.p: HIGHLIGHTS
BRUSSELS - Inter-governmental conference representatives meet (Monday-Tuesday).
BRUSSELS - EU Monetary Committee meets (Tuesday).
BRUSSELS - European Commission holds regular weekly meeting (Wednesday).
SINGAPORE - Special EU General Affairs Council (Thursday); main discussions focus on preparation for EU-ASEAN and ASEM ministerial meetings.

SINGAPORE - Meeting of EU and ASEAN (Association of Southeast Asian Nations - Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam) (Thursday-Friday); discussions on future relations between EU and Asia; closing news conference on Friday. European Commissioner Marin attends.
GENEVA - Special EU General Affairs Council in the framework of WTO negotiations on telecoms (Friday-Saturday). European Commissioner Brittan attends.
SINGAPORE - First Asia-Europe Meeting (ASEM) foreign ministers meeting (Saturday); exchange of information on regional cooperation in Asia and Europe followed by a news conference.
** Please note that the Court of Justice will break for carnival week, February 7-14 **
MONDAY, FEBRUARY 10
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Inter-governmental conference (IGC) representatives meet (and Tuesday).

BRUSSELS - European Transport Safety Council (ETSC) launches a review outlining proposals for a new EU road safety strategic plan with numerical targets (1045/0945 GMT). Venue: International Press Centre (IPC). Contact: ETSC (322) 230 4106.
MOLDOVA and TRANSCAUSCASUS (NEW ITEM) - NATO Secretary General Javier Solana begins official visit (To Saturday).
TUESDAY, FEBRUARY 11
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - EU Monetary Committee meets (1000/0900 GMT).
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - IGC representatives meet (second of two days). Closing news conference on the outcome of the meeting (time to be confirmed).
WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 12
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commission holds regular weekly meeting (0900/0800 GMT).
Provisional agenda includes:
- Commissioner Cresson communication on "Towards the fifth framework on scientific and technological objectives".
- Commissioner Fischler communication on olives and olive oil sector.
- Commissioner Monti proposal for Council directive on taxation of energy products.
- Commissioner Van Miert communication of Commission decision on the liberalisation of telecoms networks, additional delay for Portugal.
- Commissioners Wulf-Mathies, Flynn and Santer joint communication on objective 2 (1997-1999) for Germany.
- Commissioner de Deus Pinheiro communication on the decision modifying decision of December 13, 1996 granting support in the framework of special assistance porgramme to ACP banana suppliers.

BRUSSELS - Centre for European Policy Studies (CEPS) holds conference on "EU climate change policy: The road to Kyoto" (0900/0800 GMT). Agenda includes: where do we stand?; possible policy responses; economic and social implications of climate change policy. Venue: CEPS. Contact: CEPS (322) 229 3911.
THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 13
SINGAPORE (NEW ITEM) - Special EU General Affairs Council (0900/0100 GMT).
Agenda includes:
- Preparation for February 13-14 EU-ASEAN ministerial meeting.
- Preparation for February 15 ASEM ministerial meeting.

BRUSSELS - EP Green Group holds hearing on "Belarus-What does the future hold? The political developments in Belarus and the consequences for its relations to the EU" (1500/1400 GMT). Venue: EP, MAE2.

BRUSSELS - Centre for European Policy Studies (CEPS) holds lunchtime meeting on "Central and eastern Europe: preparing for membership" (1315/1215 GMT). Speaker is former Portuguese European Affairs Minister Vitor Martins. Venue: CEPS. Contact: CEPS (322) 229 3911.

SINGAPORE (EXPANDED ITEM) - Meeting of EU and ASEAN (Association of Southeast Asian Nations - Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam) (and Friday). European Commissioner Marin attends.
Agenda includes:
- (1030/0230 GMT) Singapore Deputy Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong gives opening address.
- (1145/0345 GMT) First working session:
* Exchange of views on developments in ASEAN and EU, in particular ASEAN enlargement, inter-governmental conference, economic development.
* Review of existing ASEAN-EU cooperation in areas such as development cooperation, intellectual property rights and agreements on drugs precusors and control.
* Future directions of ASEAN-EU relations.

* Political and security issues of common concern such as southeast Asia, Asia-Pacific, Bosnia, Eastern Europe, security in Asia, environment, drugs control, human rights, ASEAN regional forum, ASEAN post-ministerial conference.
* Economic issues such as WTO, commodities and generalised system of preferences.
FRIDAY, FREBRUARY 14
GENEVA (NEW ITEM) - Special General Affairs Council in the framework of WTO negotiations on telecoms (1700/1600 GMT) (and Saturday). European Commissioner Brittan attends.
BRUSSELS - Assembly of European Regions (AER) holds bureau meeting. News conference at 1230/1130 GMT.
Agenda includes:
- Initiatives concerning the inter-governmental conference and the Amsterdam European Council;
- Reinforcing of relations between the AER and the European institutions (European Union, Council of Europe, OSCE);
- Implementation of the "Declaration on Regionalism";
- Guidelines for a new "East-West" policy;
- Reinforcing of Euro-regional cooperation;
- Cooperation between the AER and local authorities;
- Programmes of action for the AER Committees.
Venue: Flanders European Conference Centre, room 2. Contact: AER (322) 211 5530.
SINGAPORE (NEW ITEM) - EU-ASEAN meeting (second of two days).
Agenda includes:
- (0900/0100 GMT) Closing plenary session and adoption of the joint declaration of the 12th ASEAN-EU ministerial meeting.
- (1100/0300 GMT) Signing ceremony to amend ASEAN-EU cooperation agreement (Acccession of Vietnam).
- (1120/0320 GMT) Closing news conference.
SATURDAY, FEBRUARY 15
SINGAPORE (NEW ITEM) - First Asia-Europe Meeting (ASEM) foreign ministers meeting.
Agenda includes:
- (0900/0100 GMT) Status of ASEM follow-up activities.
- Political dialogue on international and regional issues
* Exchange of information on regional cooperation in Asia and Europe.
* Discussion on international issues.
- Future of ASEM: preparation for ASEM II.
- (1545/0745 GMT) Closing news conference.
- (1715/0915 GMT) Launch of Asia-Europe foundation (ASEF).
SUNDAY, FEBRUARY 16
No events scheduled.
